-- What a client importing `Proof.go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.backend.InvNew` sees of it (generated by etc/gen-interface.py; do not edit).
-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

theorem backend.hook_bFresh_false (γ γ' : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (b : Loc) (st :
    backend.BSess) (stop : Bool) (m u : Nat) (hwb : γ'.wb = γ.wb) (hopn : γ'.opn = γ.opn) :
    backend.batchLocked γ P b st ∗ backend.payIn γ st stop m u ∗ backend.bFresh γ' ⊢ False

theorem backend.hooksOk_persistent (P : backend.BParams) (W Pk : backend.BNames → IProp GF) (h :
    GoInterface) : Persistent (backend.hooksOk P W Pk h)

def backend.hooksOk (P : backend.BParams) (W Pk : backend.BNames → IProp GF) (h : GoInterface) :
    IProp GF :=
  iprop(□
      ∀ γ b t,
        ▷ backend.isBackend γ P (W γ) (Pk γ) b -∗
          typedPointsto (backend.bF go!"batchTx" b) t DFrac.discard -∗
            backend.hooksSpec γ P (Pk γ) b t h)

def backend.bFresh (γ : backend.BNames) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(ownToks γ.wb backend.wbInit ∗ backend.bOpen γ 1)

def backend.newPost (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (W Pk : backend.BNames → IProp GF) (b
    : Loc) (D : backend.Data) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(backend.isBackend γ P (W γ) (Pk γ) b ∗
      backend.isStopChans γ b ∗
        backend.bOpen γ 1 ∗
          backend.bViewC γ 1 (backend.vData P (D, { bks := ∅, ver := W64 0 })) true ∗
            backend.plHook γ func.nil ∗
              ownToks γ.wb backend.wbInit ∗
                backend.rbOwn γ (backend.rbData P D) ∗
                  ([∗list] _x ∈ List.replicate sync.rwmutex.actualMaxReaders.toNat (), backend.rdTok γ P b) ∗
                    backend.dlInit γ ∗ backend.fkCl γ P D ∗ backend.srSlot b)

theorem backend.newPost_of_K (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (W Pk : backend.BNames →
    IProp GF) (b : Loc) (D : backend.Data) : backend.newPostK γ P W Pk backend.bFresh b D ⊢
    backend.newPost γ P W Pk b D

theorem backend.hook_fresh_false (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (b : Loc) (st :
    backend.BSess) (stop : Bool) (m u : Nat) : backend.batchLocked γ P b st ∗ backend.payIn γ st
    stop m u ∗ ownToks γ.wb backend.wbInit ∗ dghostVar γ.opn (DFrac.own (Qp.half 1)) false ⊢ False

def backend.newPostK (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (W Pk K : backend.BNames → IProp GF)
    (b : Loc) (D : backend.Data) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(backend.isBackend γ P (W γ) (Pk γ) b ∗
      backend.isStopChans γ b ∗
        K γ ∗
          backend.bViewC γ 1 (backend.vData P (D, { bks := ∅, ver := W64 0 })) true ∗
            backend.plHook γ func.nil ∗
              backend.rbOwn γ (backend.rbData P D) ∗
                ([∗list] _x ∈ List.replicate sync.rwmutex.actualMaxReaders.toNat (), backend.rdTok γ P b) ∗
                  backend.dlInit γ ∗ backend.fkCl γ P D ∗ backend.srSlot b)

def backend.wbInit : Nat :=
  2 ^ 40 - 1
